Tesla Owners Silicon Valley (@teslaownersSV)

We have @mayemusk coming to speak at @theXtakeover next Saturday on 10/10. 

Join us for a keynote interview with Maye Musk as she shares the stories and lessons behind her new book, Timeless: The Art of Reinvention and Resilience at Any Age. In this inspiring conversation, Maye will reflect on a life defined by courage, adaptability, and reinvention, from building her career as a dietitian and model, to raising three children as a single mother, to becoming a global icon in her later chapters. This session will explore what it means to keep evolving, embrace change, and thrive on your own terms at every stage of life.
